description: Use when the user asks who hosts a domain's email (Google, Microsoft 365...) or which services send for it. Returns providers matched from MX hosts and SPF includes, with evidence. For raw MX records use mx. Ex: 'Who handles email for example.com?'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.

domain.description: A public domain name, e.g. example.com.
